# One transaction spending US dollars out of two banks, where only the split on
# the first gives the cost basis it draws on.
#
# 500.00 USD are bought at 1.30 into the first bank and 200.00 USD at 1.30 into
# the second, each opening a cost basis. The sale then takes 100.00 USD out of
# the first bank, giving that bank's cost basis, and 50.00 USD out of the
# second, giving none. Each is valued at the 1.30 it cost, so the sale realizes
# nothing and states no gain.
#
# The 50.00 out of the second bank draws on a cost basis the book keeps, and no
# split says which one.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_every_split_that_spends_draws_on_a_cost_basis_of_its_own_side.py.
2033-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:USD Savings
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2033-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2033-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

2033-01-05 * "Buy 500.00 USD at 1.30 into the bank"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "650.00"
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000001"
	Assets:CAD Bank -650.00 CAD

2033-01-06 * "Buy 200.00 USD at 1.30 into savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Savings 200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "260.00"
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000002"
	Assets:CAD Bank -260.00 CAD

2033-02-01 * "Sell 150.00 USD out of both, one split giving no cost basis"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-130.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000001"
	Assets:USD Savings -50.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-65.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank 195.00 CAD
